quests.title: Changchang's Little Friend

dialogue.t: I hope that our puppy isn't starving...
Have you fed our puppy yet?

dialogue.sit: It should have eaten its fill.

dialogue.t: Here, this is for you. I saved it up myself just to thank you!
Granddad should be here in a few days to take me to go feed it.

quests.description: Changchang from Liyue Harbor is looking for someone to get some food for a little puppy…
